title: OpenUSD Tempo contract address correction and Solana explorer cross-check

supersedes_scope.reason: The prior artifact transcription omitted two zero characters. The Tempo Explorer page URL and address field display the corrected 20-byte address.

source_capture_policy.reason: Rendered explorer pages only; no raw HTTP bytes or provider-signed timestamp receipt.

claims_supported: Explorer page title is OpenUSD OUSD.
Explorer page displayed 'No transactions found' and 'No transfers found' at retrieval.
limitations: The page did not populate total supply or creation metadata.
No transactions displayed is not proof of no on-chain activity; explorer indexing, contract interaction model or page rendering may be incomplete.
This is an explorer index, not issuer confirmation or independent reserve attestation.

claims_supported: Displayed price is $1 and decimals are 6.
limitations: No exact provider event timestamp was displayed.
This is one-chain indexed supply, not total cross-chain OUSD supply.
Do not subtract from or sum with Bridge's all-chain API snapshot because the timestamps and measurement systems differ.
No raw response bytes or independent timestamp anchor were captured.

corrected_identity.solana_supply_scope: Solana only; explorer-indexed; retrieval date 2026-11-05; no exact provider timestamp
corrected_identity.origin_dollar_remains_distinct: Origin Dollar is a separate Origin Protocol asset with a different Ethereum contract despite sharing the OUSD ticker.

reconciliation.interpretation: Open Standard's official page describes OUSD as live on four chains and the project-linked directory lists a Tempo contract. The Tempo Explorer identifies the corrected address as OpenUSD OUSD but displays no transactions/transfers. Preserve this disagreement; do not infer live Tempo payment volume.
reconciliation.solana_supply_not_comparable_to_all_chai: Different retrieval times and source systems; no cross-chain supply arithmetic is performed.

admission.reason: Explorer-rendered identity evidence only; no byte-complete receipts, no independent timestamp anchor, no verified transaction volume and no direct XRP/XRPL relationship.
